statement: let E := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter (fun n => Even n); let P := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc (Nat.sqrt X) (2*Nat.sqrt X)).filter Nat.Prime; let H := fun (X n : ℕ) => ((P X).filter (fun p => p ≤ n ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p))).card; let M := fun X : ℕ => Real.sqrt (X:ℝ) / (Real.log (X:ℝ))^2; ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X₀, (∑ n ∈ E X, (H X n:ℝ)^2) ≤ C*(X:ℝ)*(M X)^2

plain_statement.zh: 平方根步长窗口内的路径二阶矩
plain_statement.en: Bound the square-root-window path second moment

brief.zh: 用碰撞恒等式、共同邻点筛界与位移权重均值。对角项单独用每个终点至多有 |P| 条路径。
brief.en: Combine the collision identity with the two sieve inputs; bound diagonal arrivals separately by |E||P|.
